text:
Maria (eng-platform): Heads-up — I hit a confusing UX edge when authoring routing YAML with the new `override_groups` feature. Console shows no warning for cycles in header precedence and the deployed route silently picks a surprising header value.

Sahil: ugh, can you paste a repro?

Maria (eng-platform): Repro YAML (simplified):
```yaml
routes:
  - id: r1
    match:
      path: /api/v1/*
    headers:
      X-Env: prod
    override_groups:
      - name: group-a
        headers:
          X-Env: staging
      - name: group-b
        headers:
          X-Env: prod
        inherits: group-a
      - name: group-c
        headers:
          X-Env: canary
        inherits: group-b
      - name: group-a
        inherits: group-c
```
This creates an inheritance loop and the console didn't warn, it just applied the first-seen header and logs show `header_resolution: ambiguous`.

Aisha: oof. That's a schema/validation gap. Our current JSON Schema can assert types and required fields but not detect cycles in `inherits`.

Kevin: we had a similar issue with upstream traffic-shifting rules last quarter. We solved it by adding a dedicated lint rule that runs a DAG-check on `inherits`. Could reuse that. PR was #2423.

Maria (eng-platform): Nice — link?

Kevin: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/2423 — look at `rules/inheritance_no_cycles.go` and the unit tests. It returns a structured lint error: `R-OVR-001: override_groups contain inheritance cycle (group-a -> group-c -> group-b -> group-a)`.

Sahil: two parts to action: 1) blocker lint rule in authoring pipeline + fail-save on deploy; 2) console UX — we need an in-editor hint that explains the cycle and highlights the groups involved. Also telemetry event for how often users hit this.

Maria (eng-platform): Agree. For UX copy: propose `Conflict: override_groups form an inheritance cycle. Resolve inheritance or remove duplicate group definitions.` Also show inline button "Autofix: break cycle by dropping duplicate group" (which runs a dry-run). Thoughts?

Aisha: +1 for clear copy. Autofix worries me — dropping groups could silently change behaviour. If we offer it, make it a preview-only change and show a diff + required confirmation.

lint-bot: NEW ISSUE: R-OVR-001 detected in `routes[0]`. See /lint/rules/R-OVR-001 for details.

Sahil: telemetry: event name `route_authoring.override_inheritance_cycle_detected` with props: route_id, groups_in_cycle (list), user_id, editor_mode (console/yaml). We need to ensure PII-free. Does that naming fit our conventions?

Kevin: looks good. Add `is_autofix_used` boolean and `autofix_result` enum (applied/skipped/previewed).

Maria (eng-platform): Dev plan: I'll open a tiny PR to wire the linter (reusing #2423 code) into the authoring pipeline and add the console hint + preview-only autofix. Aisha, can you review the UX copy and the confirm modal text?

Aisha: Yup — I'll draft the modal. Please include explicit line: "This preview shows the effect of removing duplicated `override_groups` definitions. It does not change production until you apply and confirm a deploy."

Sahil: Also add an integration test to our `console-e2e` suite that loads the YAML repro and asserts the lint warning appears and the diff preview shows the removed group. We had flakiness in `console-e2e` previously — tag the test as `stable` and run it in the serial queue.

Maria (eng-platform): Will do. Assigning follow-ups: Maria -> PR for linter + pipeline, Sahil -> e2e test, Aisha -> UX modal + copy, Kevin -> telemetry event and ensure the event schema is in `telemetry-registry`. I'll reference PRs in the thread once opened.

Kevin: FYI — check quota/governance: when the linter rejects a save, console should surface an opt-out link for admins to allow saving with warnings (but we should require an audit log). That was requested by enterprise customers.

Aisha: yep — add `save_with_warnings` path gated to admin roles and emit `route_authoring.save_with_warnings_attempted` telemetry.

Maria (eng-platform): Cool. If nobody objects I'll open the linter PR in the next 2 hrs.

Sahil: go for it. :thumbsup:

Maria (eng-platform): PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/2987 — includes `R-OVR-001` rule, unit tests, and console hint payload. Linking e2e ticket: PLAT-5643.

lint-bot: PR 2987 added comment: `R-OVR-001 linter integrated; please add telemetry events before merge.`

Aisha: reviewing now. small nit on modal copy.

Sahil: I'll start the e2e task. Thanks everyone.

Maria (eng-platform): Thanks — will follow up with migration notes for customers who relied on duplicate group semantics.

Kevin: appreciate the heads-up.

Maria (eng-platform): End of thread.
